description: This file defines a React component 'DoctorView' for a medical prescription interface. It manages patient details, medications, and signing of prescriptions using wallet-based cryptographic signatures. The component also displays locally stored prescription history and includes utility functions for handling IDs and clipboard interactions.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Generates a UUID string for uniquely identifying prescriptions.

methods.name: DoctorView
methods.description: Main React component that manages state and UI for creating, signing, and viewing prescriptions.
